ios.desc:
Walking Route Planner & Maps - Walks Near Me, Local Routes helps you find local routes and paths is a walking planner and tracker that helps you plan better routes, track steps live, and discover places along the way.

Create walks tailored just for you:

- Walk to work
- Walk home
- Custom walks to any destination
- Multiple stops and loops lets you shape the route the way you want

Walking Route Planner & Maps you can:
Plan walking routes with custom stops and see distance and estimated time before you start
Track distance, steps, time, and progress live as you walk
Discover nearby parks, cafés, landmarks, and scenic spots along your route
Save completed walks, check in at places, and earn badges

The pedometer keeps track on your steps:
- Your current walk
- Daily, weekly and monthly totals
- Every step you have taken while using Walking Route Planner & Maps

You can invite your friends to your walks, so you can walk and explore together.

With the Live Activity view you can follow your walk directly without opening the app.

Apple Watch lets you see where you are at any time.

Use the Smart Planner to let Walking Route Planner & Maps generate the perfect route for you.

The Smart Planner can generate anything from a coffee shop crawl to a walk full of all kind of activities.

Check in on places along the route, directly in the app or from your Apple Watch.

You can choose to share your walks and check ins with your friends, or keep them to yourself. You are in full control of your activity.

Your friends can react and comment on what you decide to share.

Walking Route Planner & Maps is free to use. Plan your walks, track distance, steps and time, walk with friends, share your walks and check ins, and follow your recent stats, all without a subscription.

Walk Mode Plus adds the Smart Planner, so the app can generate a route for you, and opens up your full stats history with every walk and every step you have taken. Start with a 14-day free trial.

You are in full control of your account and can keep it for when you return, or deleting it if you no longer need it.

quotes.text:
I built an iOS app called Walk Mode. It’s for planning walks, discovering places along the way, and sharing them with friends and family.

The basic idea is that walking is easier to stick with when it feels more interesting. Walk Mode is my attempt to make everyday walks a little more intentional and a little less routine.

It’s live here:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/walk-mode/id6761091838
